title: Feedback/Bug Reporting Broken
symptom: After updating to the 2/20 nightly, cannot send logs or submit feedback/bug reports. The app attempts sending and displays 'Error sending feedback:'. Reproduced on 2 devices. Another user reports a similar issue with 'Could not package up all logs, using most recent.' and email is never sent.
evidence_quote: I noticed after updating to the 2/20 nightly that I cannot send logs or submit feedback/ bug reports. The app appears to attempt sending it and displays "Error sending feedback:"
